newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 13.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Ivory Coast privatisation committee denies charges of bias against local consortium Africa Bell, which was disqualified from bidding for takeover of state telephone company CI-TELCOM; Says Africa Bell's bid, in partnership with U.S. group AT&T, had gross shortcomings.
- Visiting U.S. business mission to hold series of workshops on Tuesday with potential Ivorian partners in agriculture, industry, mining, energy and services, advertisement says.
- Opposition Ivorian Popular Front party condemns two-year jail sentences passed last week on three university student leaders tried on charges of inciting violence.
- Leaders of two main opposition parties, Laurent Gbagbo and Djeni Kobina, discuss with Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan on bringing the opposition into government.
- Ivorians abroad join heated debate on privatisation of phone company CI-TELCOM.
